reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is correctly empty with no counterparty comment, as expected for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports compliance: 19.2 gives a ninety-day material-conformance warranty for Deliverables running from the later of delivery or acceptance and continuous conformance for hosted Services through the subscription term, which meets and in part exceeds the playbook's fallback (and approaches/exceeds preferred for hosted software).

19.4 supplies the full preferred remedy ladder — prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, then termination of the affected item with a refund of Fees paid — and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.

The failed deterministic check ('warranty period ≥ 90 days') is a false negative: the period is spelled out as 'ninety days' rather than numerically, so the regex missed a conforming phrasing variant.

Rationale references to 19.1, 19.3, 19.5 and 6.1–6.2 (professional/workmanlike standard, no malicious code, compliance with law, disclaimer carve-out) are supporting context; nothing in the supplied paragraphs contradicts them, and no walk-away 'AS IS' disclaimer is evident.
